note: The on-screen control hints shown during play (docs/ui/hud-spec.md section 22) and the YOU labels. A scheme is a list of rows (an action or a group of actions, and a short word); the HUD shows the scheme named by its control_scheme option and falls back to 'today'. When Controls' new layouts land (ADR 0008: arena, brawler, simple, and the touch presets) each is one more scheme here, with no code change. A row with only_when_avail shows only while that action can be used. intro_seconds: how long the hints show at the start of every match (the last two seconds fade) unless prompts are on or the control_hints option is always.
